attributes.name: ypy-untrusted
attributes.description: Marks a container whose content a language model writes, with the `ypy-model` extension (included in `ypy.max`). Whatever enters it loses scripts, styles, frames, forms, svg, `ypy-*`, `data-ypy-*`, `on*` and framework attributes, `javascript:` and `data:` addresses and media that loads from the network. The value `images` keeps images.

values.name: images
values.description: Images are kept (their handlers and bad addresses are still removed).

attributes.name: ypy-follow
attributes.description: On the container of a model answer: the page scrolls down while the answer grows, only when the reader was already at the bottom and `prefers-reduced-motion` is not set.

attributes.name: ypy-stop
attributes.description: On a button: a selector of the elements that get `ypy:abort` when it is clicked, which closes their stream. The answer that was open is closed in the page as stopped. Pair it with a request of the button (`ypy-post`) that tells the server.

attributes.name: ypy-announce-start
attributes.description: The live-region text said when the answer in this container starts. Falls back to `config.announce.messages.answerStart`.

attributes.name: ypy-announce-stop
attributes.description: The live-region text, assertive, said when the answer was stopped (`data-ypy-answer="stopped"`). Falls back to `config.announce.messages.answerStopped`.

attributes.name: ypy-announce-error
attributes.description: The live-region text, assertive, said when the answer failed (`data-ypy-answer="failed"`). Falls back to `config.announce.messages.answerFailed`.

attributes.name: ypy-answer
attributes.description: Written by the server on the answer container (as `data-ypy-answer`) in the final patch: `done`, `stopped` or `failed`. The `ypy-model` extension reads it to pick the closing announcement, and writes `stopped` itself when the reader stops the answer.

values.name: failed
values.description: the server or the model failed

config.name: announce.stream
config.description: `blocks` says the text of each closed block of a model answer, shortened, at most once every 3 seconds. Unset: only the start and the end of the answer are said.

config.name: announce.messages.answerStart
config.description: Said when a model answer starts.

config.name: announce.messages.answerReady
config.description: Said when a model answer is finished (also the text of the `ypy-announce` attribute of its container).

config.name: announce.messages.answerStopped
config.description: Said, assertive, when a model answer was stopped.

config.name: announce.messages.answerFailed
config.description: Said, assertive, when a model answer failed.
